    SELECT TOP(1) [v].[VisitId], [v].[BranchId], [v].[CreatedAt], [v].[CurrentAssignmentId], [v].[Department], [v].[IsReferred], [v].[PatientId], [v].[PaymentCollectionModel], [v].[ReferralPartnerId], [v].[ReferrerId], [v].[ReferrerText], [v].[RowVersion], [v].[Status], [v].[Token], [v].[TokenDate], [p].[PatientId] AS [PatientId0], [p].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt0], [p].[CurrentPhoneNumber], [p].[DateOfBirth], [p].[DisplayName], [p].[FirstName], [p].[Gender], [p].[IsDateOfBirthKnown], [p].[IsSoftDeleted], [p].[LastName], [p].[MRN], [p].[RowVersion] AS [RowVersion0], [p].[UpdatedAt]
    FROM [Visits] AS [v]
    INNER JOIN [Patients] AS [p] ON [v].[PatientId] = [p].[PatientId]
    WHERE [v].[VisitId] = @__visitId_0
) AS [t]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [i].[InvoiceId], [i].[CreatedAt], [i].[Currency], [i].[DiscountAmount], [i].[DueDate], [i].[GrossAmount], [i].[NetAmount], [i].[Status], [i].[TaxAmount], [i].[Total], [i].[VisitId], [p0].[PaymentId], [p0].[Amount], [p0].[InvoiceId] AS [InvoiceId0], [p0].[Method], [p0].[ReceiptNo], [p0].[ReceivedAt], [p0].[ReceivedByUserId]
    FROM [Invoices] AS [i]
    LEFT JOIN [Payments] AS [p0] ON [i].[InvoiceId] = [p0].[InvoiceId]
) AS [t0] ON [t].[VisitId] = [t0].[VisitId]
LEFT JOIN [Orders] AS [o] ON [t].[VisitId] = [o].[VisitId]
ORDER BY [t].[VisitId], [t].[PatientId0], [t0].[InvoiceId], [t0].[PaymentId]
